title: Spreading by Word of Mouth — Libraries That Agree in the End
description: Epidemic algorithms told on the scholars' coast of Paxos: a change to the compendium sent by letters that go astray, a yearly festival that misses no one, gossip in the stoa that is quick and leaves a few out, and notices that carry the news that an entry is withdrawn.
question: Can an update reach every machine in a large system just by each passing it on to a few others, with no one organising the spread?
how: We find out by exploring how a change to the scholars' compendium spread from library to library by word of mouth, and how the libraries caught whatever the gossip missed.

papers.authors: Alan Demers, Mark Gealy, Dan Greene, Carl Hauser, Wes Irish, John Larson, Sue Manning, Scott Shenker, Howard Sturgis, Dan Swinehart, Doug Terry and Don Woods
papers.title: Epidemic Algorithms for Replicated Database Maintenance
